Struct.description: A structure containing the list of diagnostics to fetch for a component.
Struct.name: ComponentInput

StructElement.description: The unique identifier of a component. Supported values include 'Solr', 'FMS', 'File-Content', 'Indexing-State', 'Subscription-Table' and 'Scratch-Table'.
StructElement.name: id

StructElement.description:
A list of diagnostics to retrieve for the component. If the list is empty, all diagnostics will be retrieved.
Following are the supported diagnostics for various components -
Solr: Status, Version, Mode
FMS: Status
File-Content: Status, Mode
Indexing-State: Object-data, File-content
Subscription-Table: Oldest-timestamp, Subscribing-apps
Scratch-Table: Sync-triggers, Trigger-conditions
StructElement.name: diagnostics

Struct.description: A structure containing component details and diagnostics.
Struct.name: ComponentOutput

StructElement.description: The unique identifier of a component.
StructElement.name: id

StructElement.description: The display name of a component.
StructElement.name: name

StructElement.description: A list of diagnostics retrieved for the component.
StructElement.name: diagnostics

Struct.description: A structure containing information such as identifier, name, values that together represent a diagnostic.
Struct.name: Diagnostic

StructElement.description: The unique identifier of a diagnostic. Refer ComponentInput structure for a complete list of supported values.
StructElement.name: id

StructElement.description: A list of strings holding the value of a diagnostic. For example, the 'Status' diagnostic for FMS may include values 'OK', 'Not OK'.
StructElement.name: values

StructElement.description: The type of metrics associated with the diagnostic. Quantitative metrics may be used to display charts.
StructElement.name: metricType

StructElement.description: A list of metrics related to a diagnostic. Metrics are a collection of data points related to a diagnostic. For example, the File-content diagnostic may include metrics for states such as Success, Pending, Fail and their respective counts. This is an optional parameter.
StructElement.name: metrics

StructElement.description: A list of messages describing a diagnostic. This is an optional parameter.
StructElement.name: messages

Struct.description: A structure containing a list of diagnostics to retrieve for various components.
Struct.name: DiagnosticsInput

StructElement.description: A list of structures containing a component identifier and a list of diagnostics to fetch for the component.
StructElement.name: components

Struct.description: A structure containing a list of components and their diagnostics, and any errors encountered.
Struct.name: DiagnosticsOutput

StructElement.description: A structure containing a list of components and their diagnostics.
StructElement.name: components

Struct.description: A structure containing a message type and content.
Struct.name: Message

StructElement.description:
A string containing the contents of a message.
Following messages may be returned for Solr based on its running state –
WARN – Solr is running at 80% capacity, please consider increasing the JVM memory.
ERROR – Solr is running at full capacity, please increase the JVM memory and restart search and indexing processes.
StructElement.name: content

MetaEnum.description: A list of supported message types.
MetaEnum.name: MessageType

Struct.description: A structure containing information on a metric. For example, an indexing state metric may have a name such as Success, Pending or Fail and a numeric value indicating the count of objects in that state.
Struct.name: Metric

StructElement.description: A list of values for the metric.
StructElement.name: values

MetaEnum.description: A list of supported metric types.
MetaEnum.name: MetricType

OperationTemplate.description: This operation fetches diagnostics on components such as the Solr search engine, File Management System (FMS), Object Data, File-Content and Smart Discovery Indexers involved in the Teamcenter search and indexing processes. This information provides an overview of the health of the components.
OperationTemplate.name: Dds0::Soa::DataDiscovery::Indexer::getSearchAndIndexerDiagnostics
OperationTemplate.returnDescription: Diagnostics such as the status, configuration, and metrics for the requested components.

OperationParameter.description: The input containing a list of diagnostics to retrieve for components such as Solr, FMS, and various indexers.
OperationParameter.name: input

Operation.description: This operation fetches diagnostics on components such as the Solr search engine, File Management System (FMS), Object Data, File-Content and Smart Discovery Indexers involved in the Teamcenter search and indexing processes. This information provides an overview of the health of the components.
Operation.name: getSearchAndIndexerDiagnostics
Operation.returnDescription: Diagnostics such as the status, configuration, and metrics for the requested components.
Operation.useCase: In Teamcenter client, user navigates to the Search and Indexer dashboard. Information such as the status of Solr, FMS, Indexer tables must be displayed. Charts must display the counts of object and file-content indexing states such as Success, Pending and Fail.

ParameterInfo.description: The input containing a list of diagnostics to retrieve for components such as Solr, FMS, and various indexers.
